description: The voice scope of Content first: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: voice.roles
answers.why: Articles are the product; the UI copy must match them.

answers.question: voice.count
answers.why: Warm by default, calmer for errors.

answers.question: voice.definition
answers.why: Editors work from principles and examples, not word lists.

answers.question: voice.values
answers.why: Talk to one reader, like a good editor.

answers.question: voice.lands
answers.why: Most words are in articles and guides.

usage.use: A warm verb a reader would say
usage.why: Buttons are part of the reading voice.

usage.use: Calm and helpful. Take the blame, offer the way forward.
usage.why: A calm error keeps the reader's trust.
usage.example: We could not save your email. Check it and try again.

usage.use: Warm and brief, with what happens next
usage.why: A warm close invites the reader back.
usage.example: You're in. The next issue arrives on Friday.

usage.use: An invitation, not a dead end
usage.why: An empty list is a chance to show what the product offers.
usage.example: Nothing saved yet. Tap Save on any article to read it later.

usage.use: Gentle and clear about what changes
usage.why: Readers come back when leaving felt respectful.
usage.example: Unsubscribe from the weekly letter? You can come back any time.

usage.use: One sentence on what is here and why it is worth reading
usage.why: Occasional readers decide in seconds whether to stay.
usage.example: Practical guides, one a week. Start with the most read.

content.$description: Voice tokens: the words components use for common actions. Text, not CSS.

commit.$description: The label of the action that completes a task.

cancel.$description: The label of the way out next to the main action.

destroy.$description: The label of an action that deletes data.

retry.$description: The label that repeats a failed action.

empty-action.$description: The label of the action in an empty state.
